Article Name: Mechanical properties of ambient cured high strength hybrid steel and synthetic fibers reinforced geopolymer composites
Author: Musaad Zaheer Nazir Khan, Yifei Hao, Hong Hao, Faiz Uddin Ahmed Shaikh
Curing method: covered 24 h at 22 C / 50 % RH, then unwrapped in the same ambient lab environment (22 +/- 2 C, 50 +/- 5 % RH)
Conversions / notes: G-2. kg/m3 / B (FA + slag = 688). Plain matrix G-1 skipped (no fibre). WG = D-grade sodium silicate solution 294.3 kg/m3 (Ms 2.0, SiO2 29.4 %, Na2O 14.7 %, H2O 55.9 %; its water not added to W/B). VERIFY: NaOH 117.72 kg/m3 taken as 12 M solution mass; NaOH solid 35 % (density 1.37 g/cm3 assumed) -> W/B = water of NaOH solution only; test age 28 d from 'at 28 days of ambient curing' (compressive tests). Silica sand 1100 kg/m3. Fibres: spiral steel (25 mm, 0.55 mm, 1400 MPa) / hooked-end steel (25 mm, 0.30 mm, 2500 MPa) / HSPE (12 mm, 12 um, 3500 MPa, 123 GPa); steel diameter and strength left empty when the two steel types are mixed.
